points.description: States that sizeof returns a size (the amount of memory/storage occupied) of its operand, i.e. a size value rather than the operand's value.
points.partial_credit: Award 1 mark if the answer mentions memory/size vaguely (e.g. 'length' or 'space') without clearly tying it to the operand.

points.description: States that the size is measured in bytes (equivalent wording such as 'number of bytes' accepted).
Identifies that the size is that of the operand, which may be a variable, expression or data type (equivalent wording accepted).
